briefs.brief: PayJai / เพย์ใจ — Thai SaaS for SME payroll & HR (เงินเดือน ลางาน ประกันสังคม). Audience: owners of 10–200-person Thai SMEs. Feel: trustworthy, friendly, modern tech. Needs Thai + Latin lockups. Show each direction on a 1600x900 sheet with 16 px and 32 px favicon tiles and a one-colour version.

Seminar poster "AI for Thai SME 2027" by a Thai IT company. 15 ม.ค. 2570 13:00–17:00, hotel in Bangkok (venue (รอยืนยัน)), free registration via QR, 3 speakers (neutral photo boxes, no AI faces). A3 portrait.

Facebook/Instagram ad 1200x628 for "บ้านคั่ว", a small Thai online shop of fresh-roasted coffee beans from Chiang Rai. Promo "ซื้อ 2 ถุง ส่งฟรี". Real coffee photos from licensed free sources only, with credit.
SRS for "ระบบนัดหมายผู้ป่วยออนไลน์" of a private Thai hospital, written by a Thai IT company. Clean, trustworthy, healthcare. Cover + 1 inner page side by side, A4 each.

Company profile deck of "ส่งไว โลจิสติกส์", a Thai mid-size last-mile logistics company pitching to corporate clients. Cover slide + content slide "บริการของเรา": 4 services + 1 key number (ส่งตรงเวลา 98.6% (รอยืนยัน)). 16:9.
